positive_snippets: The room was okay. I have paid 1500 per night, so considering the Payment, the room was fine. I have travelled solo. The best part in the Hotel is their food. The half egg fry, they make is very good. Almost all the items are very very good.

The room service is excellent and the staff are very friendly. Odia-speaking guests can communicate in their native language, as the manager is from Odisha. I recommend this hotel to anyone visiting New Delhi for its affordable rates and luxurious stay.

Hotel is really very nice, rooms are neat and clean. Staff was co-operative. Only thing i have a problem is that parking space is very less and conjusted but not a big deal. Overall experience was good.
negative_snippets:
Not worth it. Only book if costs less than ₹1000. Here's why:
- Family suite Bathroom had no door lock.
- Dirty blankets clear brown & red patches on both blankets, even the replacement blankets aren't clean.
- room had broken electrical plugs.
- they didn't even provide water.
